bioprojects.title: Klebsiella pneumoniae Genome Sequencing and Assembly

description.title: Pathogen: clinical or host-associated sample from Klebsiella pneumoniae
description.comment: Klebsiella pneumoniae is an important opportunistic pathogen responsible for both community-acquired and hospital-acquired infections. It can cause severe infections particularly in immunocompromised individuals, neonates, the elderly, and intensive care unit patients. Clinical manifestations include pneumonia, urinary tract infections, wound infections, meningitis, bacteremia, and sepsis. The emergence of resistant strains has severely limited treatment options, leading to the spread of multidrug-resistant (MDR), extensively drug-resistant (XDR), and pandrug-resistant (PDR) K. pneumoniae isolates. Consequently, the World Health Organization (WHO) has classified carbapenem-resistant K. pneumoniae as a critical priority pathogen.

assemblyInfo.comments: The annotation was added by the NCBI Prokaryotic Genome Annotation Pipeline (PGAP). Information about PGAP can be found here: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genome/annotation_prok/
